observations: Front-load washing machine, silver/grey body, LG logo visible on top-left of panel (photo 0).
Display panel shows lit indicator ring and digital readout, suggesting the unit has power reaching it (photo 0).
A red 'Washer+Dryer 2 in 1' sticker on the door is peeling/worn, indicating some age or handling wear.
Loose/hanging wire visible near the top right of the unit, routing is untidy.
Floor and wall behind the unit show grime and water staining, environment looks damp.
No photo of the rear panel, drum interior, water hoses, power cord plug, or any paperwork (receipt/warranty card).

claims.claim: LG Washing machine scrap but doesn't work and needs repair
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows display lit, but no power-on test of wash/spin cycle is shown; internal fault cannot be confirmed or denied from a static photo.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: No purchase date, receipt, or usage log visible in photo 0.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened
claims.evidence: This directly contradicts the seller's own opening statement that it 'doesn't work and needs repair' (same message, photo 0 shows no internal view to settle either way).
No photo of receipt or warranty card provided.

risks.risk: Motor/drum may be seized, burnt, or damaged
risks.proof: Video of unit powered on attempting a wash/spin cycle, or photo of motor after opening rear panel

risks.risk: Control board or display fault despite lit panel
risks.proof: Video showing full cycle selection and start, with visible drum movement
Photo of rear hoses and door seal, close-up, plus a water-fill test clip

risks.risk: Rust or internal corrosion from damp storage environment seen in background
risks.proof: Photo of underside/rear chassis and drum tub

risks.risk: Receipt/warranty card authenticity and whether it transfers to a new owner
risks.proof: Clear photo of receipt and warranty card with matching serial number visible on unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, no warranty value added

proof_requests: Video of the machine plugged in, powered on, and attempting a full wash cycle with door closed
Photo of the rear panel, hoses, and power cord/plug
Photo of the data/serial plate (usually inside door rim or rear) matching the receipt
Clear photo of receipt and warranty card with visible date and serial number
Photo or video of the drum/motor area if accessible, to check for rust or burn marks
response.reason: The LG DirectDrive 6/3kg washer-dryer is identifiable from the control panel in photo 0, but the seller's own words contradict each other on whether it works, and no functional test or paperwork photo is given, so it must be priced at worst case as non-working scrap pending proof.
